name: Jellyfin
description: Jellyfin is a free software media system that puts you in control of managing and streaming your media files (movies, shows, music).
compose_template:
version: '3.8'

services:
  jellyfin:
    image: jellyfin/jellyfin:latest
    container_name: selfhost-jellyfin
    volumes:
      - {{APP_DATA_DIR}}/config:/config
      - {{APP_DATA_DIR}}/cache:/cache
      - {{APP_DATA_DIR}}/media:/media
    restart: unless-stopped

networks:
  default:
    name: selfhost-network
    external: true
